kind: actuator catalog consistency and loaded motion experiment
promotion: not promoted: calibration missing; opposite support foot unloads; small internal contact persists; no successful stepping or learning gate

floor_force_ratio_diagnostic.scope: Patch resultant |F_xy|/F_z for current world-Z floor law, excluding internal contacts and loads below the stated reporting cutoff. Not a calibrated coefficient, torsional capacity or an acceptance gate.

contact_impulse_comparison.scope: Accepted BE endpoint-force quadrature with complete coverage. Not an exact continuous impulse; no torsional impulse, energy or calibrated accuracy gate.

timestep_comparison.scope: Aligned sampled diagnostic only; motor_states and joint arrays contain mixed units. Event occurrence matching is diagnostic, not proof of identical modes. Optional accepted-stage impulse comparison is diagnostic. No energy, hardware or learning gate is established.

limits: Timing is diagnostic and includes overlap with small build/check processes, not a controlled throughput benchmark.
Clearance uses sampled compiled contact surfaces; narrow-phase proxy fidelity and full CAD clearance are not established.
Static support margin assumes three selected supports; actual contact must be checked separately.
No battery sag or temperature evolution in these fixed-boundary replays.
Corrections improve stall consistency but do not establish no-load/loaded response, passivity or hardware accuracy.
next: Inspect curved-link/crosshead contact geometry against the CAD reference and loaded motion; do not suppress contact to pass the example.
